title: Consciousness at Equilibrium

canonical_node.axiom: The minimal chi-field action S_chi at equilibrium (chi -> chi, _chi -> 0, V at minimum) yields seven emergent properties that map to spiritual terms.
definitions: chi-field: a massive, self-interacting scalar field non-minimally coupled to spacetime curvature.
Equilibrium: chi -> chi (constant VEV), all gradients vanish, potential at minimum.
Awareness (syneidsis): chi  0, the field is always on.
Mind of Christ (nous Christou): _chi -> 0, no gradients, uniform awareness.
Rest (katapausis): V(chi) is the minimum, no net force.
Discernment (diakrisis): stable coupling chiR to curvature.
Sound Mind (sphronismos): no ghosts, no tachyons, stable Hamiltonian.
Wisdom (sophia): group velocity v_g  c, causal propagation.
Relational Calibration (metriots): effective gravitational constant G_eff = G_N / (1 + chi).
derivation: Start with the minimal chi-field action S_chi.
Impose equilibrium conditions: chi -> chi (constant), _chi -> 0, V at minimum.
From V at minimum, derive Rest (.3).
From the stable coupling term, derive Discernment (.4).
From no-ghost and no-tachyon conditions, derive Sound Mind (.5).
From causal propagation (v_g  c), derive Wisdom (.6).
From the renormalized gravitational constant, derive Relational Calibration (.7).
canonical_node.action: The system should treat consciousness as an equilibrium property of the chi-field, with the seven terms as emergent spiritual attributes, and use the Consciousness Ladder to determine which terms are active at each level of voluntary coupling O.
boundary: This chain does not claim to prove the existence of consciousness; it maps equilibrium properties to spiritual terms.
It does not claim that the chi-field is the only source of consciousness.
It does not claim that the seven terms are exhaustive; other properties may emerge at equilibrium.
It does not claim that the phase form Phi_chi is derived; it is assumed by analogy.
test: Verify that each of the seven properties indeed follows from the equilibrium conditions without additional assumptions.
Check for any additional equilibrium property that contradicts the seven terms (kill condition).
Disambiguate overlaps with Chain 6 (Discernment, Wisdom) and Chain 7 (Relational Calibration).
Derive the phase form Phi_chi from the potential V(chi) independently.
Attempt Lean formalization of the derivation.
Run independent AI confirmation (David Effect test).

dg1_dependencies: Parent equation: minimal chi-field action S_chi (Paper 3, Lean-adjacent, DESI-consistent).
Standard results: SSB, no-ghost, no-tachyon, causal propagation.
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a physical model for consciousness as an equilibrium state, yielding seven spiritual terms (Awareness, Mind of Christ, Rest, Discernment, Sound Mind, Wisdom, Relational Calibration) that can be mapped to theological concepts.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the parent equation's consistency with GR at equilibrium and its experimental bounds.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If this chain is removed, the physical grounding for consciousness as an equilibrium property is lost, and the spiritual terms lack a unified physical basis.
dg5_translation_registers: Physics: scalar field theory, equilibrium, VEV, gradients, potential minimum, coupling, stability, causality, effective gravitational constant.
Theology: awareness, mind of Christ, rest, discernment, sound mind, wisdom, relational calibration.
Scripture: Acts 17:28, 1 Cor 2:16, 1 Cor 13:12, Matt 11:28, Heb 4:9, Heb 5:14, 2 Tim 1:7, Prov 9:10, Phil 4:5.

overstatement_risks: Claims that the seven properties 'emerge' from equilibrium without rigorous proof.
Maps theological terms to physical properties without formal validation.
Assumes the phase form by analogy without derivation.
Potential overlaps with other chains not resolved.
kill_conditions: Show that the chi-field at equilibrium exhibits a property not listed that is inconsistent with the seven terms.
Show that one of the seven terms does not actually emerge at equilibrium but was imposed.
Show that the parent equation is not DESI-consistent or violates experimental bounds.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the derivation of the seven properties from the equilibrium conditions in Lean, and verify the no-ghost and no-tachyon theorems.

plain_summary: This document derives seven spiritual terms (Awareness, Mind of Christ, Rest, Discernment, Sound Mind, Wisdom, Relational Calibration) from the equilibrium state of a scalar field action. The derivation is plausible but not formally verified; several open items remain, including potential overlaps with other chains and the unproven phase form. The chain is marked as defective and requires further work before acceptance.
